clips.text: Getting a pixel reel takes three steps. And one of them is pressing play.
First, add Pixel Reel to Claude. You only do this once, and it takes about a minute.
Then ask for a reel. Say what you want explained. You can paste in a link, or a whole letter.
A minute or two later, it's ready. Press play, right there in the chat. And you get a link to send to anyone you like.
